title: Quicklinks — website shortcuts with favicons
description: A grid of user-curated website shortcuts: each quicklink is a URL + label, the favicon tile is derived from the URL (Google s2), and clicking one opens a new native browser tab. SELF-CONTAINED: data lives in an injectable QuicklinksStore — the bundled default persists to localStorage and ships seeded with demo links, or point configureQuicklinks() at a host store (e.g. a shell's settings-managed list). Pairs with the appshell slice's useQuickLinks capability, which renders the same list as dock/launchpad favicon shortcuts.
